indications.indication: Hemophilia A (moderately severe to severe, adult males)
indications.trial_design: Global, open-label, multicenter, single-arm Phase 3 trial in 75 adult male patients; single 3e13 vg/kg infusion; primary endpoint annualized bleeding rate vs. lead-in.
indications.trial_status: Trial completed primary readout (Jul 2024 non-inferiority and superiority met). Sangamo regained rights April 2025; in business development negotiations for a partner.
key_milestones: Jul 2024: primary endpoint met (non-inferior and superior ABR)
Dec 2024: detailed AFFINE data presented at ASH
Apr 2025: rights returned from Pfizer; partnership discussions underway
